records.claim: 24 Solomon Islands correctional officers completed a one-month training course in China and returned June 26, 2025
records.methodology: Official government account of completed training; participant count is not unique longitudinal training coverage
records.counterfactual: Australian and other external policing assistance and preexisting bilateral cooperation remain unmeasured
records.costsAndIncidence: Training cost, funding and institutional effectiveness not established

records.claim: EU SITC energy products trade deficit was EUR 101.1 billion in Q2 2026 versus EUR 71.3 billion in Q1 2026
records.methodology: Eurostat extra-EU SITC category 3 goods balance, not bilateral Russian import attribution
records.counterfactual: Weather, global prices, demand, contracts and supplier substitution not causally isolated
records.costsAndIncidence: Aggregate trade balance is not realized consumer cost or geopolitical leverage

records.claim: EU-Japan Strategic Partnership Agreement entered into force on January 1 2025, after provisional application beginning February 1 2019
records.methodology: Council treaty register records signature, provisional application, ratification and legal entry into force; this is institutional implementation, not independent partner-policy change
records.counterfactual: Prior EU-Japan cooperation and shared strategic interests precede SPA
records.costsAndIncidence: Implementation costs and measured partner impacts not established

records.sourceOrganization: India Ministry of Mines / Press Information Bureau
records.claim: 56 critical and strategic mineral blocks successfully auctioned out of 88 unique blocks taken up for auction by the Central Government; 10 successful in seventh tranche
records.methodology: Government cumulative administrative auction count, not operational mine output or Quad-financed project
records.counterfactual: India domestic policy and private capital; Quad causal link unestablished
records.costsAndIncidence: Auction payments, capex, operational output, environmental and fiscal costs not quantified here

records.sourceOrganization: Japan Ministry of Defense / trilateral ministerial statement
records.claim: United States Japan and Republic of Korea announced full activation of real-time DPRK missile warning data-sharing mechanism after operational tests and a multi-year exercise plan
records.methodology: Official joint statement corroborated by US Department of Defense; activation is reported, performance not independently measured
records.counterfactual: Existing US bilateral warning channels and independent allied responses predate trilateral activation
records.costsAndIncidence: System costs, response effectiveness and allied burdens unmeasured

records.claim: Japanese defense briefing reports more than 11,000 North Korean soldiers dispatched to Russia in late 2024, another 3,000 Jan-Mar 2025, and at least 100 ballistic missiles supplied during 2024; figures rely on cited MSMT and other reporting
records.methodology: Third-party government intelligence synthesis with underlying source dependence; reported estimates, not independently counted by EP News
records.unit: reported personnel and missiles (not summed into score)
records.counterfactual: War demand and pre-treaty military cooperation cannot be separated from treaty impact
records.costsAndIncidence: Casualties, equipment transfers, sanctions, procurement costs and Russian reciprocal transfers not quantified here
